data.headline: We bridge the gap between academics and real practice.
data.subheadline: Stimuli IQ is a healthcare education and training platform for India's medical, psychology, and allied health science students. We teach the way healthcare actually works — live mentors, real clinical exposure, verifiable certificates — so your career readiness doesn't depend on your college tier.

data.heading: Why we exist
body: Every year, thousands of Indian medical and psychology graduates step into their careers without the practical exposure the field actually demands — not because they lack knowledge, but because academic curriculums don't match what real clinical and healthcare practice requires.

Our mentors lived that gap themselves. We built Stimuli IQ to close it: a system where students learn through real practice, are mentored by people who work in healthcare, and graduate with proof employers and institutions can trust.
Our mission: give every Indian student — regardless of college tier — access to the training and mentorship they need to build a real career in healthcare.
data.mediaAlt: Stimuli IQ "Why We Exist" poster. Healthcare needs more skilled, confident, compassionate professionals who are ready for real-world challenges. Bridging the Gap: we bridge the gap between education and real-world healthcare. Empowering Futures: we empower learners with the skills, exposure, and mentorship they deserve. Building Better Healthcare: we exist to build a stronger, more compassionate, and future-ready healthcare community. Better training today. Better healthcare tomorrow.

heading.title: How the journey works for you
heading.subtitle: One guided journey from first step to career-ready.

items.title: Discover the right program
items.description: Browse programs across psychology, neurology, clinical research, and allied health sciences — or book a free counselling slot and let a mentor guide your choice. Transparent pricing, easy pre-registration, no hidden fees.

items.title: Learn live and on-demand
items.description: Our learning portal combines scheduled live sessions with clinician mentors and recorded lessons you can rewatch anytime. Your progress and attendance stay visible in one place.

items.title: Build real case studies
items.description: Every program is structured around real-world case studies and practice scenarios — reviewed by working healthcare professionals, not graders. Your portfolio becomes the proof that shows you're genuinely prepared.

items.title: Earn a verifiable certificate
items.description: Finish your assessment and receive a certificate with a unique ID and QR code. Any employer can verify it on our public verification page in seconds.

items.title: Get career ready
items.description: Portfolio reviews, counselling sessions, and direct referrals through our network.
